title: Introduction to React
description: Learn the fundamentals of React and modern component-based web development.
author: Suman D H
courseInformation: This beginner-friendly course introduces React and its important concepts.

chapters.note: Learn what React is, why it is used, and how to create a React application.
Understand JSX syntax and learn how to create reusable React components.
Learn how props pass data between components and how state manages dynamic data.
Learn how to handle user events such as clicks, input changes, and form submissions.

title: HTML5 Semantic Elements
description: Understand modern HTML semantic elements and proper webpage structure.
author: Suman D H
courseInformation: This course teaches semantic HTML elements used to create meaningful and well-structured webpages.

chapters.note: Learn the basic structure of an HTML5 document.
Learn header, nav, main, section, article, aside, and footer elements.
Learn modern HTML forms, audio, video, and other media elements.

title: CSS Responsive Design
description: Learn responsive web design using modern CSS techniques.
author: Suman D H
courseInformation: This course teaches how to design websites that work properly on desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.

chapters.note: Learn selectors, colors, fonts, spacing, and the CSS box model.
Learn how to create flexible layouts using CSS Flexbox.
Learn how to build two-dimensional responsive layouts.
Learn how to make websites responsive for different screen sizes.

courseOutcome: Use media queries for mobile devices.
